description: This file defines the MomentsService class, which manages periodic photo capturing (moments) in a web application, including permissions, camera interaction, and linking uploaded photos to tags.

classes.name: MomentsService
classes.description: A service class managing periodic photo capture ('moments') in a web application, handling permissions, camera access, and linking photos to tags.

methods.name: enableMoments
methods.description: Enables the moments feature and starts taking photos periodically.

methods.name: disableMoments
methods.description: Disables the moments feature and stops the photo capturing interval.

methods.name: pauseMoments
methods.description: Pauses the moments by clearing the photo capture interval.

methods.name: resumeMoments
methods.description: Resumes the moments feature if enabled, restarting photo capture.

methods.name: beginTakingPhotos
methods.description: Starts the photo capturing process with interval based on debug mode.

methods.name: getDefaultTag
methods.description: Retrieves the default tag for linking photos, based on application preferences.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Captures a photo using the camera, uploads it, and links it to default tags and selected items.
